title: Veryfi — The invoice doesn't add up (Thinking Mode)
concept: A Thinking Mode feature launch. An invoice and its extracted data side by side; Thinking Mode catches one mismatch and the single value resolves from 180.00 to 108.00.
footnotes: OFFICIAL SYSTEM: NB International and DIN Pro (Veryfi's own web fonts), navy #171C3A and accents taken from veryfi.com; the wordmark is used solid in white on navy, with clear space and well over 90 px wide. No black, glow, shadow or container.
REAL: the request uses the documented Thinking Mode parameter ("thinking": "light") on POST /api/v8/partner/documents (faq.veryfi.com). The API window copies the style of veryfi.com.

ILLUSTRATIVE: the invoice is a labelled sample, and the response is labelled "Illustrative API response" unless Veryfi supplies a real API test capture. Please confirm approved palette hex values against the brand PDF; the guideline page only showed swatches as images.
